text:
tara_sales: FYI - Prospect 'Aureus' wants a 2-week POC using a customer-provided GGUF (mistral-custom-q4kv). They asked for model compatibility checks, tokenizer verification, KV cache smoke test, KMS + IP allowlist steps, and a Dedicated pricing estimate. Can SE/infra/security help triage?

sahil_se: Do they have the exact GGUF and tokenizer.json? Also need target latency and expected traffic profile. Streaming? func-calling?

tara_sales: They'll provide GGUF + tokenizer.json. Targets: p50 <160ms for ~64-token prompts, avg 6 rps, bursts to 25 qps. No streaming, outputs must be reproducible for evals.

joel_infra: We can run a quick local conversion/inspect. Commands to run if they share files:

python tools/convert_to_redwood.py --input model.gguf --out /tmp/aureus --quant q4_kv
redwood-runtime inspect /tmp/aureus --kv-test

If inspect fails, send artifact securely and I can run traces.

sahil_se: I'll start a model-scan in onboarding (tokenizer check, op compatibility, perf regressions). Link: https://console.redwood.dev/model-scan?id=PROJ_TMP

nina_sec: Security notes: confirm if prompts include PHI/PII. For POC we need data residency, retention, and whether PII scrubbing is required. Hosted requires KMS integration; Dedicated can accept customer KMS. Also need export-control attestation for customer-provided weights.

tara_sales: POC will use scrubbed data. They prefer Dedicated for isolation and will provide KMS key.

maya_legal: If they provide weights, we'll need an attestation and signed SOW limiting scope to the POC. I'll prepare templates and ask for customer legal contact.

joel_infra: Fallback option: if q4_kv conversion or latency issues occur, we can route to a validated mistral-33b-quant variant. Suggest canary routing to compare outputs.

sahil_se: Ballpark Dedicated cost for 2-week reserved capacity (2x A100 equiv to hit 25 qps): ~$10k + $1.5k storage/ops. Finalize with finance.

tara_sales: Can someone draft a short preflight checklist I can send Aureus?

sahil_se: Preflight: 1) GGUF + tokenizer.json, 2) sample prompt set + expected eval metrics, 3) target RPS & latency SLOs, 4) data residency / PHI confirmation, 5) KMS key ARN + IP allowlist, 6) export-control attestation, 7) desired start date/timezone.

nina_sec: Add retention period for logs/outputs and whether PII scrubbing is needed. For regulated data we require Private deploy or BA.

ops-bot: [CI] model-scan queued job_id=ms-3315000000-1 (status: queued) :gear:

joel_infra: If they can't share weights, offer NDA + presigned S3 upload where we run scans and return a report; we won't retain copies. I'll own conversion.

tara_sales: I'll ask Aureus for the artifact, attestation, and prompt set. Internal sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to finalize SOW and quote?

sahil_se: 11:00am PT works for me. Joel/Nina/Maya?

joel_infra: +1

nina_sec: available

maya_legal: I'll review the SOW draft asynchronously unless needed live.

tara_sales: Thanks all — will send calendar invite and the preflight to the customer doc. :raised_hands:
